summary: Commit 2bfbd373f changes classification.md, report.md and plan.md only. The blog merge removed 1709 cases: gate-257a6b0c.json gives 3094 - 1385, and the per-post sweep over 119 posts gives 1726 cases before the merge and 17 after. So 1494 + 1709 = 3203, which is 28 above 3175. The projection note, the f97a72f90 table row, the reverted D5 marks and the plan 4.17 wording are correct. No 81/54/3121 cut figure, line citation or run-file count remains. The final values agree: 1494, 1681 (52.9 %), 92.08 % and 3064 (96.5 %). Two wording items do not block.
nonblocking_findings: N13 (counterfactual wording, changed line): report.md section 1 says 'Without the blog merge, the suite holds 3203 cases, the final 1494 plus the 1709 cases the blog merge removed.' The 1709 comes from the 119 posts at task 3.5. Master later added one en post and one th post (121 now). The old per-post file would now hold 14 x 121 + 2 + 59 = 1755 cases, so the unmerged suite at HEAD would hold about 3232 cases, not 3203. The sentence defines 3203 as that sum, and the conclusion holds either way: there is no net cut without the blog merge. Suggested text: 'the final 1494 plus the 1709 cases the blog merge removed at task 3.5'. Also add the sources of the computed figure (green-at-f97a72f9.log, gate-257a6b0c.json; computed).

N14 (stale projection text, ADV-P1-10 remainder): classification.md, Approved merge line section, still ends 'The second lever is the primary-advantage content pin set (102 D5 cases); its replacement design decides the final count.' ADV-P1-10 named this line, but the new note covers only the Projected cut block. After the D5 revert that lever no longer exists. Suggested: extend the note to this sentence.
